# Test fixtures

Mermaid sources taken from [Pele](https://github.com/obsidianmd/pele) (MIT licensed, see its `LICENSE`),
used by `test/corpus.test.js`. Each file is a JSON array of `{ "name": ..., "source": ... }`, which is also the
input format of `pele2svg --batch`.

| File | Sources | Where they come from |
|---|---|---|
| `featured.json` | 58 | The examples listed on [pele.run/examples](https://pele.run/examples) (named `<type>-<n>`). |
| `docs.json` | 520 | The "Documentation examples" of the per-type pages of pele.run/examples (`<type>-<nn>`). |
| `layout.json` | 81 | The "layout cases" drawn first on the per-type pages of pele.run/examples (`website/src/lib/layout-cases.ts`, named `<type>-layout-<group>-<n>`). Pele chose them to show how a type is laid out. |
| `reference.json` | 170 | The `src` of Pele's own conformance corpus (`tests/corpus/*-reference.json`) that is not already in the files above (`<type>-ref-<nnn>`). Sources that Pele itself rejects (about 60, deliberately invalid inputs) are left out. |

`featured.json`, `docs.json` and `layout.json` are generated by [`scripts/build-fixtures.mjs`](../../scripts/build-fixtures.mjs)
from a clone of the Pele repository. It bundles Pele's own selection code (`website/src/lib/examples.ts`, the code
that builds pele.run/examples) with esbuild and calls it on `tests/corpus/*-docs.json`, so the fixtures are what
the site shows: `exampleGroups()` gives the featured examples, `examplePages()` the documentation examples and the
layout cases. A Pele example that Pele cannot draw is left out of `featured.json`, as on the site.

```sh
node scripts/build-fixtures.mjs --pele <path to the pele clone>
```

Running it on Pele 1.10.0 (the clone's `package.json`) reproduced the earlier `featured.json` and `docs.json`
exactly and added `layout.json`. `reference.json` comes from `tests/corpus/*-reference.json` and is not
generated by this script. If Pele starts rejecting a source, the corpus test names it in its failure message.
